audio.transcript:
Bekzod: You won't believe what happened at the science hackathon last Friday! While our team was testing the sensor prototype in the workshop where we built it, a sudden storm cut the electricity.
Nodira: Oh no! Did you lose all your test data?
Bekzod: Almost! Fortunately, a student who sat at the table beside us lent us a portable battery which kept the laptop running.
Nodira: That was lucky! So did you eventually present on stage?
Bekzod: Yes, we eventually reached the final milestone and finished in second place!

Aziz: Earlier, some teammates suggested adding dark mode first, since users asked for it.
